lede: The web's feeds mostly agreed on sport this Sunday: são paulo x internacional surfaced on both Google Trends and Polymarket at once, the strongest of three cross-feed clusters, with UFC 331 and the 2026 Asian Games close behind. Away from the pitch, a true-crime wave carried Lizzie Borden to the top of Wikipedia at 973,878 views, pulled along by the new series Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story. On GitHub, cloudflare/security-audit-skill led trending with 3,155 stars in a day, while Counter-Strike 2 held Steam with 1,317,931 concurrent players.
